newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Coffee due higher, seen locked in range.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Coffee due higher, seen locked in range.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA40
LIFFE coffee futures are stuck in a range, with little sign of the direction of the next move, analysts said on Monday.
Benchmark September was expected to open around $30 higher, traders said.
The only way to tell the direction of coffee's next big move was to see whether support or resistance went first and "follow the break," Adrian Haylor, technical analyst at Sucden, said.
New York coffee futures posted moderate gains in extremely thin trading on Friday as the market made a half-hearted attempt to bounce back from Thursday's tumble to three-month lows, dealers said.
Colombia's June coffee crop totalled 1.07 million 60-kg bags compared to 858,000 bags in the same month last year, sources at the National Coffee Growers Federation said Friday.
For the first six months of this year, the harvest was running at 4.7 million bags compared to 5.3 million in the first six months of 1996, according to federation figures.
No damaging cold is in sight over the next five days in Brazil's coffee growing regions, independent forecaster Weather Services Corporation said.
